precedence: this amendment overrides only Open Drawer maintained-contact missed-interaction eligibility and intervention timing in amendment 1
reason: RVT development established that real Panda-finger-to-active-drawer contact first appears during native gripper closure, so requiring contact before the open-to-close transaction makes the frozen cell physically ineligible by construction
unchanged: semantic object and Panda finger mappings
relation-loss semantics and the 0.15 second stable-relation requirement
result denominator and development gate thresholds

open_drawer_missed_interaction.observation_location: after every completed simulator step inside the same native open-to-close gripper transaction
open_drawer_missed_interaction.eligible_event: first simGetContactInfo contact onset between one of the four frozen Panda finger collision shapes and the active drawer shape for the current variation
open_drawer_missed_interaction.intervention: at the first eligible contact onset, stop further closing at the earliest adapter-supported simulator-step boundary and reverse the selected gripper to open amount 1.0 without changing the arm path or drawer state
open_drawer_missed_interaction.distinction_from_relation_loss: missed interaction intercepts the first contact onset before a maintained relation exists; relation loss requires validated contact to remain stable for at least 0.15 seconds before opening the gripper

forbidden: using proximity or distance as the eligible contact event
using policy task state, policy belief, alarm output, cycle fraction, final success, or post-hoc outcome to select the event
waiting for the close transaction to finish before recording the eligible contact onset
treating a later closed-gripper hold command as a new open-to-close transaction
moving, resetting, translating, or directly setting the articulated drawer or its joint
changing the arm path or TCP target
counting a transient contact onset as relation loss without 0.15 seconds of stable validated contact
changing labels in the original failed development rows

development_repair.rvt: archive and invalidate the complete amendment-1 development bundle, then rerun all 180 assigned episode IDs under one amendment-2 fault-adapter identity
development_repair.racer_not_started: run the complete 180-row development set under amendment 2
development_repair.racer_already_started: apply the same invalidation rule to every result produced under the superseded Open Drawer missed-interaction definition
development_repair.full_rerun_reason: the frozen development gate requires one non-empty value for each of seven result identities across all 180 rows; retaining 170 amendment-1 rows would mix fault-adapter identities or falsely rebind old executions
full_rerun_archive_requires: the original episodes aggregate and failed gate with SHA256
one immutable per-episode artifact for each of the original 180 assigned episode IDs
